title: Privilege-sculpting Terraform module + upgrade checker for Private deploys
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Deliver a reusable Terraform module that 'sculpts' least-privilege IAM policies and RBAC constructs for Private (VPC) deployments, plus a companion upgrade-checker that validates role/policy changes before rollout. This ticket covers the module API, canonical policy templates, upgrade-time safety checks, automated drift/health assertions, and CI/observability hooks.

Scope:
- Terraform v1.4+ module that generates: service accounts / roles / role bindings (GCP) and IAM roles & policies (AWS), a JSON policy manifest, and non-privileged auxiliary roles for observability & backups.
- A 'privilege-sculpt' transform that prunes broad allow-actions based on resource tagging and a role-affinity map (maps services -> minimal actions).
- Upgrade checker: a CI job + small CLI that applies plan in a sandbox, runs smoke-assume tests, runs OPA/Conftest policy gates, and emits a human-readable change summary and a policy-delta hazard score.
- Health checks: terratest / integration suite that verifies the ability to assume role, KMS decrypt, read model artifacts from object storage (S3/GCS), and access VPC endpoints. Failure modes map to quick remediation playbooks.
- Telemetry & drift detection: export policy-hash and binding-diffs to console/telemetry; enable weekly plan-diff job with alerting for drifts above threshold.

Module interface (high-level):
- variables (strings): environment, customer_id, resource_prefix, role_affinities (json string), allowed_actions_overrides (list), ephemeral_session_seconds
- outputs (strings): policy_manifest_url, role_template_hash, binding_manifest_s3_key

Acceptance criteria:
- Module can be instantiated in a private-deploy sandbox and produce least-privilege policies for an example tenant (e2e used in PR).
- Upgrade-checker CI reproduces plan in isolated account/namespace and runs the smoke suite within ~10 minutes for typical change.
- OPA/Conftest gates detect obvious wildcards and disallowed actions and block merges.
- Documentation: README, example usage, migration guide from current IAM scaffolding, and an incident runbook for rollback.
- Security review completed and signed off by Security team.

Non-goals:
- Not implementing a full policy suggestion ML model in this ticket — only rule-based suggestions and a hook for future model suggestions.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge module + tests behind feature flag.
2) Onboard internal dev sandbox + run upgrade-checker against 2 internal Private deployments.
3) Canary: apply to a single low-risk customer-managed Private deploy with on-call; run smoke tests.
4) Expand to automated rollout across Dedicated onboarding flows and add auto-fallback on failures.

Risks & mitigations:
- Overly restrictive policies that break runtime: include a 'break-glass' emergency role that is auditable and requires approval.
- Terraform drift causing silent breaks: enforce weekly plan-diff job and automated rollbacks for critical failures.
- Upgrade-checker false negatives: ensure terratest covers negative cases and maintain a 'canary-run' window before broad rollout.
